notes:
- Melee weapons upgrade to Tier III at the upgrade machine, like guns (same prices). Each tier hits
  harder and cuts through more zombies; Tier III also swings faster and adds the weapon's own effect:
  knife Lifesteal (each hit heals you), bat Shockwave (knocks back and stuns zombies around the
  target), axe Execute (zombies under half health die in one hit), katana Blade wave (every swing
  sends a slash 8 m ahead).
- Weapon prestige. At level 50 a gun or melee weapon can be prestiged (up to P5) in the Gunsmith: back
  to level 1, every attachment and camo stays unlocked, +2500 XP, and a P badge. P1, P3 and P5 unlock that
  weapon's prestige camos (Veteran Bronze, Veteran Silver, Master Gold).
- Warden Cole has his own model (armoured guard with cap, badge and baton), an arrival cutscene, and
  bellows to rally zombies. Once beaten he comes back every 4-5 rounds. The Alpha and the Warden only return
  after their quest is done in that game, and the Alpha is much tougher.
- Mayday ending: the evac chopper flies in over the flares and the Alpha brings it down. The supply
  crate lands at the wreck.
- Drop-in co-op: joiners get catch-up points (75% of the others' average) and spin a wheel for their
  spawn gun while they wait for the next round.
- Reworded text across the menus, story cards, perks and pop-ups (shorter and plainer). Quick Fix only
  describes what it does in your mode (solo or co-op).
- Event pop-outs: Blackout, Thick Fog, Horde, Supply Drop and power coming back now slide in at the
  bottom left with an icon. Camo unlocks show a small card with the gun turning in its new camo.
- Blizzard overhaul: swirling snow, drifting snow clouds, frost spreading over the floor and ice shards
  that shatter when it ends.
- Your camo everywhere: wall buys, the Mystery Box and the upgrade machine show guns in your equipped
  camo (the upgrade machine switches to the tier camo when it's done).
- More graphics options in Video: shadows, ambient occlusion, SSIL, global illumination, volumetric fog,
  bloom, film grain, anti-aliasing, a max FPS, and an FPS cap when the game isn't focused (30 by default).
- Performance: only the 8 lamps nearest you cast shadows (maps have over 100), which was the main cost
  in late rounds with lots of zombies.
- Prison: zombies also drop from ceiling vents onto the upper floors; open cells have wide doorways so
  zombies can follow you in; no catwalk bridge over the stairs in short cell blocks; clear space in front
  of every staircase.
- Le Chonks spawn inside the map instead of outside windows.
- Collectibles sit where they belong: keycards in wall key cabinets, intel on filing cabinets, patient
  charts on medical carts, breaker panels on the wall.
- Models: Mag-50 rebuilt; the hand cannon's foregrip and heavy barrel line up with the gun; the
  handgun Fast Mag is a base pad instead of a second mag sticking out of the grip.
- Solo: the first Quick Fix costs 500. The last zombie of a round sprints. Picking up a fuse or battery beats
  repairing a barricade. The LAN port only shows for LAN-only hosting.
- Fixed: spectating a teammate in a tight spot showed the inside of their head (a black screen with a gas
  mask). Fixed: furniture through upper-floor posts, gym bleachers in front of doors, a bench blocking
  stairs, main menu zombies vanishing in view.
